All tools/QR Code Generator

QR Code Generator

Turn links, text and contacts into a scannable QR code.

Use high contrast colors for reliable scanning.

Your QR code, ready to go.

Your files stay yours. All processing happens on your device.

How to use this tool

  1. Choose a URL, text or contact card.
  2. Enter your content and choose contrasting colors.
  3. Download the PNG, then test it with your phone camera.

Good to know

Do QR codes expire?

The generated code is static and has no expiry. The destination link must remain available.

Are my files or text uploaded?

Processing happens in your browser. Toolora does not send your files or text to a server. Close the page to clear the tool session.
